items.title: Cabo Verde Has Made History at the World Cup. Can It Convert Attention Into Bookings?
items.summary: The island nation draws 1.2 million tourists a year — predominantly from Europe, and predominantly on all-inclusive packages. A World Cup run won't change that overnight, but it may bring awareness to Americans who struggle to place the island nation on a map.

items.title: Marriott Outspends Rivals on TV, But Airbnb Owns the World Cup
items.summary: Marriott outspent every hotel brand on national TV, yet Airbnb's World Cup ads have out-reached Marriott's so far. Marketers should note that focus, rather than budget, wins marquee experiences.

items.title: OTAs Are Betting on Traveler Trust. But the Scramble Is On to Win the Trust of AI Agents
items.summary: Whether or not travelers trust AI would almost be irrelevant to OTAs if the LLMs don't trust them enough to surface their inventory for discovery.  The contest is on behind-the-scenes battle to become the LLMs' OTA fave.

items.title: Noble Investment Group’s Extended-Stay Bet Is Behind a 149-Hotel Buying Spree
items.summary: With other investors sitting on the sidelines, Noble is buying hotels from REITs and overleveraged owners at a discount — and betting that extended-stay demand will outlast the current rate headwinds.

items.title: UAE Bets on Discounts, Insurance, and New Visa Markets to Refill Hotel Rooms After Iran War Hit
items.summary: The UAE is running two recovery tracks at once — emergency incentives to plug a war-driven demand hole and multibillion-dollar infrastructure bets. The gap between those timelines is the story.

items.title: Booking.com Built Its India Business on Leisure — Now It’s Going Corporate
items.summary: India's business travel boom gives Booking.com a rare chance to grow two businesses at once — corporate bookings today and leisure loyalty tomorrow.

items.title: Expedia’s First IShowSpeed Video Brought Awareness. The Latest Pushes for Bookings.
items.summary: With a shoppable IShowSpeed video, Expedia is trying to convert creator hype into transactions.

items.title: Trump Administration Moves to Repeal Obama’s Airfare Transparency Rule
items.summary: It's the latest move to roll back consumer protections and enforcement measures against airlines.
